title: Continuous HuggingFace Model Researcher
description: A daily sched_service tick that discovers new HuggingFace models, checks real (not headline) hardware feasibility, auto-benches local-feasible candidates through hex's existing test path, and surfaces non-local candidates via hex inbox for human approval before any paid API call.

behaviors.description: The researcher runs on a daily cadence, not continuously
given: hex-nexus is running with sched_service active
when: 24 hours (HF_RESEARCH_INTERVAL_SECS) have elapsed since the last tick
then: a new discovery cycle fires
it fetches HuggingFace's public models API via the existing WebFetchPort with FetchFormat::Raw
no new port or adapter is created for this fetch

behaviors.description: Previously-discovered models are not re-surfaced or re-tested every cycle
given: a model repo already exists as a row in the discovered_model table
when: the daily discovery tick runs and encounters that same repo again
then: the existing row is not duplicated
the model is not re-pulled or re-benched if it already has a bench_result
the model is not re-surfaced to hex inbox if it already has a review_status

behaviors.description: A model whose smallest real quantization fits this box's hardware is tested automatically, no approval gate
given: a newly-discovered model's smallest available GGUF quantization is under this box's real GPU+RAM capacity (16GB GPU / 30GB RAM)
when: the discovery tick evaluates this candidate
then: local_feasible = true is recorded for this candidate
the model is auto-pulled via the same path as `hex inference add ollama --model <name>`
the model is auto-run through the existing `hex bench agentic` / `hex inference bench` commands
no human approval is requested before pulling or benching
the bench_result is recorded on the model's discovered_model row

behaviors.description: A model that needs a paid API or exceeds local hardware is never auto-tested, only surfaced
given: a newly-discovered model's smallest available quantization exceeds this box's real GPU+RAM capacity, OR the model is only accessible via a paid cloud API
when: the discovery tick evaluates this candidate
then: the model is NOT auto-pulled
the model is NOT auto-benched
no paid API call is made
the candidate is logged to the discovered_model table with local_feasible = false
a notification is raised via the existing hex inbox mechanism for human review

behaviors.description: Negative spec: the researcher must never cause a paid API call without explicit human approval, under any code path
given: any discovered model, regardless of size, architecture, or claimed capability
when: the discovery tick runs to completion for that model, unattended, with no human present
then: no request is sent to any paid/metered inference provider (OpenRouter, Z.ai, or similar) on behalf of this model
the only external network calls made autonomously are: HuggingFace's free public API (discovery), and Ollama's local pull (free, local disk/compute only)

behaviors.description: Feasibility is judged on actual smallest-quant file size, not headline parameter count
given: a discovered MoE model advertises a large headline parameter count (e.g. hundreds of billions) but has a much smaller quantized GGUF variant available
then: the resolver checks the actual file size of the smallest available GGUF quantization for that model repo
the feasibility verdict is based on that real file size compared to this box's GPU+RAM capacity, not on the headline parameter count

behaviors.description: A HuggingFace API failure does not crash sched_service or block other ticks
given: HuggingFace's public models API is unreachable or returns an error on a given day
when: the daily discovery tick attempts its fetch
then: the failure is logged
that day's cycle is skipped
sched_service's other ticks (e.g. run_improvement_cycle) continue running unaffected
the next day's tick is still scheduled normally
